# archestra_blob_provider (Data Source)

Looks up a blob provider by name (API 1.5.0-rc.30 or later). Fails when no provider, or more than one, has the name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference a blob provider created in the UI by name.
data "archestra_blob_provider" "finops" {
  name = "FinOps exports"
}

resource "archestra_cost_export" "hourly" {
  name             = "Hourly LLM spend"
  blob_provider_id = data.archestra_blob_provider.finops.id
  schedule         = "hourly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Blob provider name.

### Read-Only

- `has_credentials` (Boolean) Whether static credentials are stored for this provider.
- `id` (String) Blob provider UUID.
- `type` (String) Provider type: `s3`, `gcs` or `azure_blob`.
